home.title: Hi, I'm {name}
home.subtitle: I help you run your AI team from anywhere.
home.signedOut: Sign in from your Chalyb account to continue.

sso.failed: We couldn't open your session. Sign in again from Chalyb.
sso.missingToken: The sign-in link is missing. Sign in from Chalyb.

desktop.title: Open Chalito to finish
desktop.body: You're signed in. Go back to the desktop app to finish signing in.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.body: Chalito uses your Chalyb account. No new password needed.

companion.title: Choose your companion
companion.body: You can change it any time. Soon you'll be able to upload your own image or model.

name.title: Name it
name.body: If you rename it, we show the credit line underneath.

connect.title: Connect your AIs
connect.body: We only use each provider's official options. Your keys stay on your computer.
connect.expertBody: Paste your API keys in the desktop app or with "chalito keys set". We never send them to the cloud.
connect.later: You can connect them later in Settings → Connections.

billing.title: How you pay
billing.body: Your plan and credits come from your Chalyb account.
billing.byo: Your own keys: what you use is billed by each provider to your account.
billing.energy: Chalito energy: drawn from your Chalyb balance.
billing.both: Both: your keys first, energy when needed.
billing.tierUnknown: We don't know your Chalyb tier yet.

phone.title: Your phone
phone.body: For WhatsApp messages and calls when something is urgent. Optional.

pair.title: Connect your computer
pair.body: Install Chalito on your computer and pair it with the Chalito glyph.

passkey.title: Protect your approvals
passkey.body: High-risk actions ask for your passkey.

settings.title: Settings

phone.label: Phone
phone.invalid: That number doesn't look valid for the chosen country.
phone.willSend: We'll text you a code to verify it.
phone.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment.
phone.error: We couldn't verify the number. Try again later.
phone.willCall: We'll call you with a code.
phone.inUse: That number is already on another account.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp alerts
whatsapp.hint: We message you when something needs your attention.

calls.label: Calls
calls.hint: We call you if something is urgent and you don't respond.

callBriefing.label: Call briefing
callBriefing.hint: On a call we read you one line per pending item.
callBriefing.plaintext: Those lines leave your computer unencrypted so they can be read aloud.

quietHours.label: Quiet hours
quietHours.hint: No calls or messages during these hours, except emergencies.

privacyMode.label: Private mode
privacyMode.hint: Use your own keys from your device and store only encrypted content.

connections.label: Connections
connections.none: You haven't connected any AI yet.

settings.needsAck: First confirm you understand that charges may apply.
settings.chargesAck: I understand that charges may apply.

anthropic.name: Claude
anthropic.howTo: Claude Code connects only with your Anthropic API key. Anthropic's rules don't let us use your Claude subscription.

openai.name: ChatGPT
openai.howTo: Codex works with your OpenAI API key or your ChatGPT plan (Sign in with ChatGPT). The ChatGPT plan is available only to the Chalito team for now.
openai.ownerOnly: ChatGPT plan: Chalito team only for now

xai.name: Grok
xai.howTo: Grok Build works with your xAI API key or your Grok login.

google.name: Gemini
google.howTo: Use your Google AI Studio API key.

download.title: Download Chalito
download.body: The Linux, Windows and macOS apps are coming soon.

pwa.description: Your companion that runs your AI team.

live.testMode: TEST MODE: simulated data, nothing is real.

gate.signed_out: Sign in with your Chalyb account to see your sessions and approvals.
gate.unpaired: This browser isn't trusted yet. Approve it from a trusted device or pair it from the desktop app.
gate.error: We couldn't connect. Try again in a moment.
gate.revoked: This device was removed from your account. Pair it again from a trusted device.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.body: This is a {risk}-risk action. Confirm with your fingerprint, face or security key.

approval.sealed: The details are encrypted for another device.
approval.stepUpNeeded: Approving asks for your fingerprint, face or security key.
approval.needsPasskey: To approve high-risk actions, protect this device with your passkey.

session.sealed: The card is encrypted for another device.
session.untrusted: That computer isn't paired with this device.

devices.title: Devices
devices.devModeOffSent: Done: asked to turn it off.
devices.revokeConfirm: Remove {name}? It won't be able to approve anything.

settings.server: Your settings are saved to your account.
settings.device: Sign in to save your settings; for now they're kept on this device.

error.rejected: Couldn't save: verify your phone and confirm that charges may apply first.
error.failed: We couldn't save that change. Try again.
error.charges_notice_required: First confirm you understand that charges may apply.
error.country_not_supported: Calls to this country aren't available.

notification.notFound: That alert no longer exists or isn't yours.

passkey.title: Protect your approvals with your passkey
passkey.body: To approve high or critical risk actions from here, we'll ask for your fingerprint, face or security key. Your computer verifies it.
passkey.afterPairing: Once you pair your computer, we'll ask you to create a passkey on this device.
passkey.cancelled: You cancelled the passkey; you can try again.
passkey.error: We couldn't create the passkey. Try again.

consent.title: {client} wants to connect to Chalito
consent.gone: That request no longer exists or expired. Connect again from the app.

error.passkey_failed: We couldn't confirm with your passkey.
error.challenge_expired: That took too long; try again.

consent.badRedirect: The return address isn't safe; we won't send you there.
consent.needsDevice: To allow it, open this page on a paired device.
consent.needsPasskey: Allowing it asks for your passkey.

connectors.title: Connected apps
connectors.failed: We couldn't load your connected apps.
connectors.signedOut: Sign in to see your connected apps.

sharing.label: Share card with connected apps
sharing.warning: The card (goal, state and last action) will be stored unencrypted so your connected apps can read it.

wait.title: Use this browser
wait.body: To see and approve your sessions here, a device you already trust has to approve this browser.
wait.signInFirst: First sign in with your Chalyb account in this browser.
wait.unavailable: This browser can't be added right now. Try again in a moment.
wait.waitingBody: On your phone or another trusted browser, open Devices → Add a device and scan this ring or type the code.
wait.glyphLabel: Ring to scan from a trusted device
wait.whereToApprove: Before approving, check the fingerprint is the same on both devices.
wait.doneBody: This browser is now trusted. To send instructions to a computer, pair it with that computer too.

error.expired: The code expired. Show a new one.
error.unavailable: This browser can't be added right now. Try again in a moment.
error.endorsement_mismatch: The approval isn't for this browser. Try again.
error.endorser_not_trusted: The device that approved is no longer trusted.
error.device_exists: This browser was already registered. Show a new code.
error.rejected: The approval wasn't accepted. Try again.

add.title: Add a device
add.body: On the new device, sign in to your account and open “Use this browser”. Then scan its ring or type its code.

scan.scanning: Point the camera at the ring.
scan.denied: No permission to use the camera. Type the code.
scan.unavailable: The camera isn't available. Type the code.

add.compare: Check this fingerprint matches the one on the new device:
add.withPasskey: We'll ask for your passkey when you approve.
add.withoutPasskey: That device will be able to approve actions just like this one.

error.invalid_code: That code isn't valid. Check it.
error.not_found: We couldn't find that code. Check it or show a new one.
error.expired: The code expired. Show a new one on the other device.
error.wrong_account: That device belongs to another account.
error.step_up: Your passkey is needed to approve. Try again.
error.not_trusted: This device is no longer trusted.
error.tampered: The details don't match. Don't approve it; show a new code.
